content.title: Wyndham Park Playground Renovation
content.summary: The Wyndham Park playground underwent a renovation as part of the City's Taking Lasting Care program, with the new playground opening to the public in July 2025. The design incorporated community feedback and features custom play structures for different age groups, swings, interactive panels, and new seating and trash receptacles. Construction began in late May 2025, following a community engagement survey conducted in Fall 2024.
content.body:
![New Wyndham Park playground with bright-colored slides and play structure ](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=6115 "New Wyndham Park playground with bright-colored slides and play structure ")

As part of the [City's Taking Lasting Care program](/1115), the playground at Wyndham Park ([6236 Braun Cir.](https://maps.app.goo.gl/mAutphXeLndwWPLp9)) was renovated in 2025!

The new playground opened to the public in July of 2025. The City's Parks and Urban Design team incorporated feedback received from the community to select the playground's theme and equipment.

## New playground features

- Custom play structure for ages 2-5 with Eko Blocks and a Monaco Slide
- Custom play structure for ages 5-12 with 360 Loop, Evolution Climber and 144-inch Cobra Corkscrew Slide
- Single-post swings
- StemPlay panels
- Freestanding seek and find panel
- Friendship playful bench and STEM playful bench
- Full poured-in-place (PIP) surfacing
- Four new benches and two new trash cans

## Project timeline

- Fall 2024: Speak Up Arvada survey open for community members to provide feedback
- Winter 2024-25: The City’s Parks and Urban Design team, in collaboration with a selected consultant, will review the results of the survey and incorporate that feedback into the final design
- Spring 2025: The Parks and Urban Design team will share the final playground design with the community
- Late May 2025: Construction will begin on the new playground
- Summer 2025: Construction completed and playground open to the public

## Community engagement

A [Speak Up Arvada survey](https://speakup.arvadaco.gov/r3165) was open through Sunday, Oct. 6, 2024 to gather feedback from community members about their preferred playground themes and equipment.

The City's Park's and Urban Design team incorporated feedback received from the community to select the playground's theme and equipment.
